title: lithospermum confundum
intro: Lithospermum confundum, commonly known as Gromwell, is a flowering plant native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Gromwell include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects. Gromwell is also used in traditional medicine for its potential to support cardiovascular health and as an anti-aging agent due to its antioxidant properties.
